summary: Lower an explicit base-class constructor to C# when it does not exploit JavaScript constructor return replacement or dynamic arguments semantics.

target.notes: Emit a C# instance constructor and lower the JavaScript constructor body after required instance-element initialization.

semantics.parameter_semantics: must be handled by parameter/coercion rules

caveats: Field initialization ordering is governed by separate class-field rules.
JavaScript argument count/default/rest semantics must be preserved by parameter lowering.

tests.name: ordinary base constructor
tests.input: class C { constructor(x) { this.x = x; } } console.log(new C(4).x);

tests.name: edge: object return excluded
tests.input: class C { constructor() { return {x: 9}; } } console.log(new C().x);
tests.expected_behavior: prints 9; this rule must not match because C# constructors cannot replace the constructed object
